updates.title: University squads, spirit scores, masters rules

items.text: Five universities' squads by name (Loughborough, Bath, KCL, Leeds, Exeter) from their own posts: squad flow, who plays club, where graduates go.
Each university page: squad flow with leavers coloured by whether we see them playing after university; before, during and after; clubs connected.
Students who play club while at university are seen in the sport after it far more often (48% vs 4% of leavers we can judge).

items.card: University leavers seen in the club game
items.text: Trends: the share of university leavers seen playing afterwards, by the season they left.
Engagement: a Recreational population (sessions, hats, beginners events, leagues) alongside club, university, junior and masters; and what kinds of event the UKU calendar lists each year.
New Spirit page: UKU's published spirit scores 2021-22 to 2025-26, by kind of event and season, highs and lows, and spirit against retention. Spirit over time on every club and university page.

items.card: Do university players who also play club
items.text: New finding (university → club) and four university questions in the question bank; age limits from eligibility rules added to the age finding.
Club pages: spirit received and given at every scored event, best and lowest, by kind of event.
Masters sides at open-age events (Tom's Tourney) can take young pickups: those are marked as pickups, never counted as masters players.
Masters, Grand Masters and Great Grand Masters ages confirmed (30/33, 37/40, 45/48) and recorded; no player in the data breaks them.
